subject: Quick note on Adlard Print's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Adlard Print stood out.

Ruddington commercial printers on The Green since the letterpress days - and adlardprint.com/contact.html still runs Dreamweaver MM_swapImage image rollovers and publishes Fax: 0115 945 6474 beside the main telephone. Serious in-house print capacity; a contact page that still treats 2000s web tooling and fax as current.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
